The Ring of Fire

The Ring of Fire is a webring I created using webringu. The name is based off of the Pacific Ring of Fire. I made it because my name is Fire.

How to join

  1. Your name must be Fire
    • you can have multiple names, just one of them has to be Fire
  2. That's it.

Application

Please send me an email with:

  1. the link to your website
  2. what you would like your title to be
  3. a link to your website button (if you have one)
